conflicts.fact: Amina (10 m, 38°) and Baraka (20 m, 22°) are said to calculate the same tank height, but the numbers do not give equal heights, and L7 gives specific heights
conflicts.versions: L1/L3/L7 use 10 m at 38° and 20 m at 22°. tan38°×10 ≈ 7.8 m, while tan22°×20 ≈ 8.1 m. L7 records 'same h ≈ 8 m (7.8 m and 8.1 m)'. L1 says they 'should calculate the same height'. The sequence mixes exact and approximate consistency, though the values are only roughly consistent.
